prose: Author, researcher and documentary maker Clint Richardson returns to help us find clarity on what is real and what is artificial. We explore occult language dynamics, the gods vs. God, Simulation & Simulacra, our choices with the legal realm, and what the phrase "time is money" is really saying.
ext: We discuss the mythology of democratic voting, what it means (legally) to be enfranchised (hint: it has to do with corporations), why teaching in parables is effective, the royal bloodlines who rule from the shadows, the legal status of race and gender, the law of nature and charity, and much more. We tacked on an extra 80 minutes in this extension and I'm sure even that will leave you wanting more, so make sure to check out Clint's work online.
